decisions.cancel_condition: Cancel if an H1 candle closes below 1.40080 before entry, or if price gaps through 1.40230 without a controlled trigger.
decisions.news_proximity: Unknown from supplied market context; server-side/live execution checks remain authoritative.
decisions.exposure_note: Single CAD-short exposure selected; correlated EURCAD/GBPCAD continuation candidates were excluded to avoid stacking CAD risk.
decisions.reasoning: USDCAD produced the cleanest fresh H1 expansion in the 18-symbol universe: the 06:00 UTC bar advanced from about 1.40091 to 1.401735 and printed 1.402245, extending the sequence of higher closes from the 04:00 and 05:00 bars. A buy-stop just above that completed-bar high requires continuation confirmation rather than chasing the close. The stop sits back below the breakout base/06:00 open area, while the target preserves 2.5R. Other CAD crosses showed similar strength, so only USDCAD is proposed to keep directional CAD exposure concentrated in one trade.

message: TRADE: USDCADc BUY_STOP 1.40230, SL 1.40080, TP 1.40605. One CAD-short exposure only; correlated CAD crosses excluded.
